an3.93:1.1: tīṇimāni bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pavivekāni paññāpenti.
an3.93:2.1: tatridaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cīvarapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti : sāṇānipi dhārenti, masāṇānipi dhārenti, chavadussānipi dhārenti, paṃsukūlānipi dhārenti, tirīṭakānipi dhārenti, ajinānipi dhārenti, ajinakkhipampi dhārenti, kusacīrampi dhārenti, vākacīrampi dhārenti, phalakacīrampi dhārenti, kesakambalampi dhārenti, vālakambalampi dhārenti, ulukapakkhikampi dhārenti.
an3.93:2.2: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā cīvarapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:3.1: tatridaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā piṇḍapātapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti :
an3.93:3.2: sākabhakkhāpi honti, sāmākabhakkhāpi honti, nīvārabhakkhāpi honti, dadduḷabhakkhāpi honti, haṭabhakkhāpi honti, kaṇabhakkhāpi honti, ācāmabhakkhāpi honti, piññākabhakkhāpi honti, tiṇabhakkhāpi honti, gomayabhakkhāpi honti, vanamūlaphalāhārā yāpenti pavattaphalabhojī.
an3.93:3.3: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā piṇḍapātapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:4.1: tatridaṃ bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā senāsanapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti : araññaṃ, rukkhamūlaṃ, susānaṃ, vanapatthaṃ, abbhokāsaṃ, palālapuñjaṃ, bhusāgāraṃ.
an3.93:4.2: idaṃ kho bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā senāsanapavivekasmiṃ paññāpenti.
an3.93:4.3: imāni kho bhikkhave, tīṇi aññatitthiyā paribbājakā pavivekāni paññāpenti.
an3.93:5.1: tīṇi kho panimāni bhikkhave, imasmiṃ dhammavinaye bhikkhuno pavivekāni.
an3.93:5.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā ca hoti, dussīlyañcassa pahīṇaṃ hoti, tena ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:5.4: sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, micchādiṭṭhi cassa pahīṇā hoti, tāya ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:5.5: khīṇāsavo ca hoti, āsavā cassa pahīṇā honti, tehi ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:5.6: yato kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, dussīlyañcassa pahīṇaṃ hoti, tena ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:5.7: sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, micchādiṭṭhi cassa pahīṇā hoti, tāya ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:5.8: khīṇāsavo hoti, āsavā cassa pahīṇā honti, tehi ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:5.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu aggappatto sārappatto suddho sāre patiṭṭhito.
an3.93:6.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, kassakassa gahapatissa sampannaṃ sālikkhettaṃ.
an3.93:6.8: sīghasīghaṃ palālāni uddharāpetvā sīghasīghaṃ bhusikaṃ uddharāpeyya.
an3.93:6.13: evamassu tāni bhikkhave, kassakassa gahapatissa tāni dhaññāni aggappattāni sārappattāni suddhāni sāre patiṭṭhitāni.
an3.93:7.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, yato bhikkhu sīlavā ca hoti, dussīlyañcassa pahīṇaṃ hoti, tena ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:7.2: sammādiṭṭhiko ca hoti, micchādiṭṭhi cassa pahīṇā hoti, tāya ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:7.3: khīṇāsavo ca hoti, āsavā cassa pahīṇā honti, tehi ca vivitto hoti.
an3.93:7.4: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu aggappatto sārappatto suddho sāre patiṭṭhitoti.
